request.objective: Bound each Bright Data search task with a positive finite monotonic runtime budget, count actual HTTP attempts, and durably preserve mapped partial results on timeout.

implementation.blocking_io: Each urllib socket operation uses at most the lesser of the remaining task budget and the existing 45-second socket timeout. Synchronous read1 calls refresh the socket timeout against the monotonic deadline, including stdlib chunk framing; no worker is created.
implementation.diagnostics: Provider metadata includes actual requests_submitted, task_timeout_seconds, and task_elapsed_seconds; existing token and secret-key sanitization remains applied.
implementation.partial_expiry: Timeout during result retrieval or mapping returns earlier mapped records as RETRYABLE with TIMEOUT failure class and no completion evidence; the unchanged shared coordinator persists records before marking the task incomplete.
preserved: record caps, mappings, provenance, truncation and error semantics
